description: Next.js page component for the 'Explore' roles feature. Implements user interface for searching, filtering, and displaying roles and suggested roles, with backend API integrations for roles data.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a relative path, correctly handling slashes.

methods.name: safeParseSalaryUsdRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary range string (e.g., '$130k-$210k') and converts it from USD to INR lakhs, returning min and max values.

methods.name: mapSearchRowToUiRole
methods.description: Transforms raw backend role data into a UI Role object with specific fields and formatting.

methods.name: mapRecommendationToUiRole
methods.description: Transforms a RecommendedRole object into a UI Role object, primarily for suggested roles.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main React component implementing the 'Explore Roles' page, managing state, API calls, and rendering the UI.
